claims.claim: Original Chinese BERT often segments Chinese at character level; Chinese WWM requires word segmentation to group characters.
claims.locator: README 简介 / Whole Word Masking description
claims.verification_note: Official HFL project explicitly mentions LTP Chinese segmentation and Chinese BERT character units.

claims.claim: WWM selects token groups corresponding to entire words, while MLM still predicts original individual token IDs on selected positions.
claims.locator: §III Whole word masking; method and training data generation
claims.verification_note: Cross-checked with HFL README: mask means broad 80/10/10 corruption, not all literal [MASK].

claims.claim: MacBERT reformulates MLM as correction with semantically similar words and uses SOP, WWM and N-gram mask strategies.
claims.locator: §4 MacBERT; §4.1 MLM as correction and §4.2 SOP
claims.verification_note: Extended IEEE/ACM journal source §IV-A/B provides 80/10/10 sampled-token rule; mechanism only, not reimplemented here.

claims.claim: ERNIE original paper includes entity-level and phrase-level knowledge masking.
claims.verification_note: Not generalized to all other papers named ERNIE or to generic KG embedding.

claims.claim: ChineseBERT combines character embeddings with glyph and pinyin embeddings.
claims.verification_note: Paper is distinct input-feature approach, not the same mechanism as WWM sampling.

claims.claim: HFL Chinese checkpoints differ by tokenizer, pretraining corpus and objective; results tables are benchmark-specific.
claims.locator: README pretrained model catalogue; downstream test tables
claims.verification_note: Avoid interpreting model naming as identical English RoBERTa settings; no ungrounded ranking.
